notes.title: In New Ice York you punch a dog, go to hell, and climb a menu
notes.notes:
Start climbing at the bottom or the top.

I have a special fondness for things that are unlike anything else.

If you asked me what New Ice York is like, it would be hard to explain.

I suppose it s a puzzle game?

I think time starts to loop in it, but by the nature of the game it s hard to tell.

The main character is a detective with a cool haircut, but later he’s in a bus crash, and wears bandages.

(more…)
